rules: Keep coordinator logical-return/throw and target-enter/return/throw as independent observed axes. Exactly one logical terminal; exactly one target-enter and at most one target terminal for the selected first target.

A logical-throw may be recorded while target remains entered, and target-return/throw may be observed afterward before cut. The late target event cannot replace the earlier scope-first-error or logical outcome.

Do not reject later continuation observations solely because logical-throw was already recorded. Per-target order still requires enter before terminal and pair-enter after target-enter; target-return requires the actual pair invocation.

Logical failure while target remains entered is prefix with an explicit appropriate reason, never complete. Later complete declared focus coverage does not convert the logical failure into business success.

Target=unreached means only that first postreceipt target was not observed to enter by cut. Activation-child and its original retained Promise may already exist and fail earlier; do not reject or omit them solely for unreached.
Do not derive target terminal from p2 settlement or coordinator terminal. p2 settlement, target await and logical decision are three separate observations.
Any reducer omission remains prefix/PROJECTION_GAP and preserves observed target terminals as mandatory. Source observation order is not global physical-cause order.
